## How to Use This Site

- **Find an SOP:** Use the sidebar navigation or the search bar (top right).
- **Download a PDF:** Each SOP page has a "View as PDF" link at the top.
- **Suggest a change:** Click the "Edit this page" link on any SOP, or
  [open an issue](https://github.com/marclos/SOPs/issues/new).
- **Create a new SOP:** Copy `lab_sops/SOP-TEMPLATE.qmd`, fill it in, and
  submit a Pull Request.

### SOP Numbering Scheme

| Category                       | Field SOPs   | Lab SOPs     |
|:-------------------------------|:-------------|:-------------|
| General safety and admin       | F001--F099   | L001--L099   |
| Equipment                      | F100--F199   | L100--L199   |
| Instrumentation                | F200--F299   | L200--L299   |
| Water / aquatic methods        | F300--F399   | L300--L399   |
| Soil methods                   | F400--F499   | L400--L499   |
| Air / atmospheric methods      | F500--F599   | L500--L599   |
| Microbes, plants, and animals  | F600--F699   | L600--L699   |
| Molecular biology and DNA      | F700--F799   | L700--L799   |
| Data management and analysis   | F800--F899   | L800--L899   |

[Complete Set of SOPs (pdf)](https://marclos.github.io/SOPs/EA-Program-SOPs-Complete.pdf)
